Best for conceptual queries. Neural semantic search — finds pages by meaning, not just keywords.

Part of [`seek web`](seek-web.md).

## Usage

```text
seek web exa [options] <query...>
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query...` | Yes, one or more | Search query |  |

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-n, --num <number>` | Number of results | `10` |
| `-t, --type <type>` | Search type: auto \| fast \| neural \| instant \| deep-lite \| deep \| deep-reasoning | `"auto"` |
| `--category <name>` | Restrict to a category (e.g. research paper, news, company, github) |  |
| `--text` | Include full page text snippets | `false` |
| `--start <date>` | Only pages published on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD) |  |
| `--end <date>` | Only pages published on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD) |  |
| `--system <text>` | System prompt to bias the search (sources to prefer, novelty, etc.) |  |
| `--json` | Emit raw JSON response |  |
| `-h, --help` | display help for command |  |

## Exit statuses

`seek web exa` exits with one of the [exit statuses of `seek`](seek.md#exit-statuses).
